# GLightbox

`glightbox.min.js` and `glightbox.min.css` from GLightbox 3.3.1
(https://github.com/biati-digital/glightbox, MIT, LICENSE.md), unchanged,
as published on npm:

    https://registry.npmjs.org/glightbox/-/glightbox-3.3.1.tgz
    sha512-nXoKfJRnQTDaAFAw5799hjpfAAHx5aLvOLG0SIGudeMCwtHgO3P2/avNYapJ+SL4UEZxO2YNBPtq6pzMhSx42g==

The contact sheet page loads them from `CONTACT_SHEET_DIR/assets/`, so
it needs nothing from the internet. To upgrade, replace the three files
from the new tarball's `dist/` and update this note.
